title: Concept: MD5 use via md5.convert (dart) — review required
description: In dart, md5.convert computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The dart-specific remedy is sha256.convert.
applicability: dart codebases hashing data through md5.convert; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
